instruction_problem: No instruction line at all, only the sentence; the learner is not told what to do (drag a card into each gap). "Hurry up!" is a natural cue, not superfluous.
sense_problem: Distractor "would be" is wrong only because of the real-condition "miss" (a few learners/natives might accept it loosely as less natural, not correct). "are being" and "being be" style combinations are clearly wrong.
